name: Earshot Acoustic Verification Skill
purpose: Acoustic verification, audio measurement, loudness/spectral checks, and procedural sound synthesis.
capabilities: True peak and integrated loudness measurement (EBU R128)
Spectral bandwidth and noise floor audit
Procedural micro-SFX synthesis (clicks, thocks, pops, risers)
Acoustic quality auditing for Gate 5 signoff

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace skill. CLI available in .venv/bin/earshot.

licensing.notes: Workspace skill wrapping open-source earshot toolkit.

security.notes: Zero network traffic; procedural synthesis and local audio analysis only.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 9 Gate 5 acoustic verification.
